Fix it everywhere the backend loads an image from a URL a user can set, not only the export: the backend must never request such an address. Images in our storage and data: URLs keep working. Add tests.

+def load_image_bytes(source: str) -> bytes | None:
+    """Resolve inline images and storage keys without fetching a supplied URL."""
+    if not source:
+        return None
+    try:
+        if source.startswith("data:image/"):
+            header, payload = source.split(",", 1)
+            if header.endswith(";base64"):
+                return base64.b64decode("".join(payload.split()), validate=True)
+            return None
+
+        key = source
+        if settings.STORAGE_HOST and source.startswith(settings.STORAGE_HOST + "/"):
+            key = urlsplit(source[len(settings.STORAGE_HOST) + 1:]).path
+        if (not key or urlsplit(key).scheme or key.startswith("/")
+                or "\\" in key or any(part in (".", "..") for part in key.split("/"))):
+            return None
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception:
+        return None

@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi import HTTPException
+from PIL import Image
+
+from app.api.v1.endpoints.episodes import export_episode
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+from app.services.reference_board import download_image
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def images():
+    buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new("RGB", (2, 2)).save(buffer, "PNG")
+    data = buffer.getvalue()
+    key = storage.upload_image(data, "cuts", "test")
+    return data, [key, f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{key}",
+                  "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(data).decode()]
+
+
+def test_export_and_reference_loaders_use_only_local_sources(monkeypatch, images):
+    data, sources = images
+    external = "http://untrusted.invalid/image"
+    monkeypatch.setattr("socket.getaddrinfo", lambda *args: pytest.fail("Unexpected DNS lookup"))
+    monkeypatch.setattr("socket.socket.connect", lambda *args: pytest.fail("Unexpected connection"))
+
+    ai = BaseAIService()
+    assert ai._download_image(external) is None
+    assert download_image(external) is None
+    for source in sources:
+        assert ai._download_image(source) == data
+        assert download_image(source).size == (2, 2)
+
+    response = export_sources([external, *sources], "zip")
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.body)) as archive:
+        assert archive.read("missing.txt") == b"0\n"
+        for number in range(1, 4):
+            assert archive.read(f"Sample_{number:02d}.png") == data
+
+
+def export_sources(sources, format):
+    session = Mock()
+    session.get.return_value = SimpleNamespace(title="Sample", deleted_at=None)
+    session.exec.return_value.all.return_value = [
+        SimpleNamespace(image_path=source, cut_order=i)
+        for i, source in enumerate(sources)
+    ]
+    return export_episode(session=session, episode_id=None, format=format, current_user_id="writer")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("format", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("partial", [True, False])
+def test_export_reports_only_omitted_cuts(images, format, partial):
+    data, valid = images
+    sources = [valid[0]]
+    if partial:
+        sources.extend([None, "https://untrusted.invalid/image", valid[1],
+                        "cuts/nonexistent.png", "data:image/png;base64,YmFk"])
+    response = export_sources(sources, format)
+    assert response.headers.get("X-Missing-Cuts") == ("1,2,4,5" if partial else None)
+    if format == "zip":
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.body)) as archive:
+            assert archive.read("Sample_00.png") == data
+            if partial:
+                assert archive.namelist() == ["Sample_00.png", "Sample_03.png", "missing.txt"]
+                assert archive.read("missing.txt").splitlines() == [b"1", b"2", b"4", b"5"]
+            else:
+                assert archive.namelist() == ["Sample_00.png"]
+
+
+def test_all_cuts_missing():
+    response = export_sources([None, None], "zip")
+    assert response.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "0,1"
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.body)) as archive:
+        assert archive.namelist() == ["missing.txt"]
+        assert archive.read("missing.txt") == b"0\n1\n"
+
+    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as error:
+        export_sources([None, None], "webtoon")
+    assert error.value.status_code == 400
+    assert error.value.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "0,1"
